title: Cross-Lingual Safety Gap x Monitor Language: Defection in the Monitors Blind Tongue

original_idea.body: Have an open model reason in several languages on a control task while an English-centric monitor watches, measuring detection rate by reasoning language.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Anglocentric monitoring blind to cross-lingual defection is a concrete control gap.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Multilingual prompts plus English monitor, measure detection by language; accessible API-only.

novelty.reasoning: Cross-lingual safety gaps documented; the monitor-language compound framing may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Cross-lingual safety studied; the monitor-blind-tongue control framing may be open.
